acceptance: Reproduce the difference on chDB or ClickHouse Server and name the root cause location (fork translation, a BenchBox variant, or ClickHouse setting).

Fix so a missing key yields NULL on ClickHouse (e.g. an adapter/variant using a presence check) with an execution-based test against DuckDB, or record why no exact equivalent exists and make the query fail loudly or be excluded.
Affected published bundles are identified by id and flagged; replacement reruns are scheduled in the rerun item.
context: 2026-10-31: Reproduced on standalone ClickHouse 26.11 and chDB 3.7.2: Map subscript of an absent key returns the value type default (0 for Decimal); no setting changes it. Root cause is the hand-written clickhouse variant of map_access in read_primitives catalog queries.yaml, not the fork, so a BenchBox-side variant is the right layer (no fork PR/wheel). Fix in PR #3877: mapContains guard + ORDER BY, chDB-vs-DuckDB execution test (fails on old variant). Affected published bundles (ClickHouse Local read_primitives, all ran the defective text with 10 rows): SF0.01 3465d4f3 and 9f79ff77; SF0.1 c1aeca88 and 3f5c94e9. 3465d4f3/c1aeca88 carry defective-macdbgen-addresses (superseded); 9f79ff77/3f5c94e9 carry defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result (flagged by #3678). No other bundle used the clickhouse variant. Replacement reruns needed after #3877 merges: ClickHouse Local read_primitives SF0.01 and SF0.1 (to be scheduled in the rerun item; not run here). Unflag 9f79ff77/3f5c94e9 only when replacements publish.
description: Adjudication (2026-10-28) found the read_primitives map_access query on ClickHouse returns 0 for a missing map key where DuckDB returns NULL, so a missing key becomes a plausible value. The owner decided to treat this as a defect (not accepted engine semantics). Published ClickHouse read_primitives bundles that ran map_access are being flagged under defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result by the flagging PR.
